title: openai-chat-completions-parity: params/roles/stop/logprobs/formatting + streaming stability
author: Maya Chen
description: Bring the /v1/chat.completions compatibility layer up to parity for params, roles, stop/logprobs handling and response formatting; stabilize streaming adapter for function/tool call workflows. Motivation: customers relying on OpenAI-compatible API observed differences in role attribution, stop-sequence behavior, and logprobs output compared to reference responses; streaming path also had an intermittent message-ordering flake when tool calls were proxied. This PR updates the compatibility layer decoding and param mapping, extends unit and integration tests against the OpenAI reference corpus, fixes streaming adapter edge cases (out-of-order finalization when tool objects are attached), and adds structured-output normalization for function calls. Backwards compatibility: preserves existing Redwood API shape but adds explicit runtime flags to enable strict OpenAI semantics for legacy clients. Checklist: ensure test coverage, update docs, run full e2e parity suite, coordinate with SDK teams for minor typing changes, and run canary on Dedicated. See commits and CI below.
commits: a1b2c3d: openai-compat: map chat params (max_tokens, temperature, presence/ frequency penalty) and preserve unknown params for passthrough
d4e5f6a: compat: normalize role tokens and system/user/assistant ordering per OpenAI reference
f7a8b9c: streaming: fix adapter finalization race when tool/function objects are attached to final chunk
b0c1d2e: output: include logprobs/top_logprobs when request asks for them and match OpenAI keys
c3d4e5f: tests: add chat parity regression suite and multiple stop-sequence scenarios
review_comments: Ben Gardner (2025-11-16): Please add a unit test for concurrent streaming finalization when two tool results arrive in the same tick. The race looks plausible in the adapter.go path.
Maya Chen (2025-11-16): Added a deterministic unit test and a small refactor to gate finalization behind a single atomic; pushed new commit f7a8b9c.
Diego Alvarez (2025-11-17): LGTM on the param mapping but can we add one integration vector where stop sequences are multi-byte/unicode? Edgecases were failing in earlier runs.
Maya Chen (2025-11-17): Added unicode stop sequence test and a note in docs about canonicalization. CI re-run green.
Aisha Patel (2025-11-18): Minor nits on docs wording and an API note for SDKs; approve after docs update.
Ben Gardner (2025-11-19): Approved — verified e2e parity suite locally and on staging canary.
merge_commit_message:
openai-compat: chat.completions parity for params/roles/stop/logprobs + streaming stability fixes

Squashed commit of the above changes. Improves compatibility and addresses streaming finalization race in tool/function call flows.
release_notes: Added OpenAI /v1/chat.completions compatibility improvements: params mapping (max_tokens/temperature/penalties), role normalization, stop-sequence behavior, logprobs output keys, and streaming stability fixes for tool/function calls. No breaking changes for Redwood-hosted clients; opt-in flag available for strict OpenAI semantics.
